description: Flags Python code that mixes units, like milliseconds passed as seconds.
notes: Static analyzer: infers unit+scale from identifier names, typing.Annotated metadata, and a stdlib call-convention table; reports mismatches in call arguments (ORB001), arithmetic/comparison (ORB002), assignments (ORB003), returns (ORB004). Stdlib only, Python 3.11. Novelty confidence Medium; closest prior art Phys/Phriky-Units (C++/ROS).
